subject: Re: Arithmetic sampling status: diversity confirmed, variance win is the real story
body:
Farah, Daniela,

Repositioning based on your numbers. The readout leads with variance reduction, not diversity: 40% fewer samples for the same confidence interval is a cost story every eval owner in the building understands, and it doesn't depend on the temperature question.

Decisions:

1. Primary pitch is arithmetic sampling as the default sampler for our offline eval and reward-estimation jobs. Maren, scope that with Tomas's group after the readout.
2. Production decoding integration is deferred — the low-temperature result means it needs a temperature study we haven't budgeted.
3. Farah writes up the reproducibility property (precomputed codes, fixed seed, batch-invariant outputs) as a standalone note. That may be more valuable to us than either headline.

Readout June 15.

Dmitri
